name: triple_selector_v2_subdivision_guard
interpretation: Development-only hypothesis. The candidate must show coherent 3x timing and low-frequency inner pulses weaker than current-beat anchors, intended to distinguish true faster tactus from subdivision/bar-accent illusions.
guardrails: Do not retune this rule after viewing independent holdout outcomes.
